title: Chapter 721
paragraphs: Chapter 721
Episode 180. Individual Battles (11)
Mary clenched and opened her eyes repeatedly. As her blurred vision cleared, Diphus's figure gradually came into focus.
“Ugh…!”
Unconsciously, Mary's mouth tightened as she checked Diphus's condition.
Facing the sight of Diphus, with about ten holes the size of a fist all over his body and his lower half completely twisted in the opposite direction, she realized again that it was reality.
A reality that was hell itself.
“So, your mind is... finally returning…”
A streak of blood trickled down from Diphus's dry eyes.
He remembered how he had fallen into corruption and what he had done after that.
And he knew what he should do now, what he should say to Mary.
"You're telling me your mind has returned? So, don't kill Diphus? How can I trust what you say...!”
Mary alternated between looking at the dagger lodged in Diphus's hand and his eyes.
'This might be another trap set by the corrupted Diphus. But if Diphus really has returned, what should I do...!'
Whether she should pull out that dagger and stab Diphus again, or listen to him.
She couldn't decide whether she should listen to what would surely be his last words.
“Mary… listen to me… If the curse is triggered now, it's all over. And….”
You shouldn't give up like me, keep fighting bravely.
With your youngest sibling.
Diphus's eyes closed as he barely finished his sentence.
“Diphus!”
Frantically, Mary put her ear to Diphus's face and chest.
She felt a very faint breath and heartbeat, and Mary soon came to a conclusion.
'I have to save him first. Even if it leads to his death again, I must save him and hear why he did this.'
She couldn't go on living without hearing directly from Diphus the reason for this nightmare. She couldn't be sure she wouldn't despair.
The temporary alliance fleet was preparing to retreat.
'A flare! I need to send a rescue signal quickly…!'
But most of her belongings were smashed along with the snake. Only powdered scabs and sand came out of the pocket where she had drawn the dagger.
She screamed towards the sky several times, but her allies couldn't hear her at all.
Normally, she would have filled her voice with energy and made the whole battlefield tremble, but now she was so tired that it was hard to even keep her body up.
Still, Mary, who was trying to carry Diphus and move, stretched out her hand to him several times but then shook her head.
Unless a magician like Valeria seals him, or a healer like the Holy King directly assists, it was impossible to move while keeping Diphus alive.
In the end, all Mary could do was wait for such an ally to come.
Praying fervently that Diphus's breath wouldn't cease until then.
"You have quite a strong spirit, Prophet." Jin said.
On the battlefield where the inner wall was, the battle between Jin and the Prophet was nearing its end.
[Crack, ugh...]
The prophet's physical form, so huge it could fill the entire Ricalton Castle and still have some leftover, was now nowhere to be found, only filled with a sea of dark flames.
Jin was applying eternity flame to the remnants of his spirit, sparsely remaining like mold.
The remaining spirit chunks were barely five.
Each time Jin slashed one of them with his blue blade, the Prophet screamed in agony.
"But now the end is truly in sight."
Four, one more chunk of spirit disappeared.
[Stop, st, stop it!]
"From the moment I first learned of your existence, I've been waiting for this day."
As if embodying Jin's anger, eternity flames were swirling like a typhoon everywhere.
All those eternity flames were the spirits that were once the prophet's physical form.
Three, two, the last one.
With one spirit remaining, Jin stomped it and bulged his eyes.
"Let's end this."
Thud!
The blue shimmering blade struck the last chunk of spirit.
Then the spirit chunk shattered like glass, and sharp fragments flew out, but those fragments were made up of a different power, not of spirit.
'Spiritual energy?'
Spiritual energy.
In the past, Dox mistook the prophet's spiritual energy he saw in Ricalton for Jin, thinking he was related to him.
Jin was momentarily surprised, like Dox at that time, but only for a moment.
He had been aware for some time that there was some relationship between spiritual energy and chaos.
[Don't you wonder how I can handle spiritual energy? The 12th generation. Let's make a deal! If you let me go now, I will work for you in the future.]
"Prophet."
Interrupting the Prophet's words, Jin twisted the blade lodged in the spirit.

"There are people in the world who will never fall. Those people will never deal with you, and I am one of them. Why you can handle spiritual energy? That's obvious. Perhaps Solderet once blessed Helluram. Or Helluram stole his powers."
[Ahh! You will surely regret rejecting me, you can torture me, but you cannot obliterate me! That's impossible!]
Indeed, the last chunk of the Prophet's spirit did not disappear even though it was shattered and burning.
However, Jin silently amplified the eternity flame.

Although Jin didn't know what the Prophet meant by 'extinction', he was clearly receiving a distinct sensation from the blade. The sensation that the eternity flame was gnawing at the Prophet's life force.
Jin only had one worry.
If Diphus died before the eternity flame completely consumed the guy's life force. If not, there was no chance of the situation being reversed.
[Roar!]
"Jin!"
A white dimensional gate opened, and Syris and Valeria appeared again. The two had been searching for their remaining allies on the battlefield and had hastily come to Jin.
It was because of the orb.

Valeria had brought the orb, 'Helluram's Record Device', that Jin had obtained from Joshua's villa, to the battlefield. Before going to the Caldoran snowfield, Valeria had found out that the Prophet had come from that orb.
So, in this operation, she had wanted to examine the orb more closely, and she had just finished analyzing it.
When Valeria pulled out the orb from her pocket and held it out to Jin, the energy of the Prophet resisting the eternity flame rapidly became unstable.
The orb that Valeria offered to Jin was tinged with purple, unlike when they first acquired it at the villa.
[Mo, mother. How did you guys...!]
As a Prophet, she could not even imagine the orb popping out now.
From the start, she didn't even know that Joshua had the orb of spiritual energy, or that it had been stolen by Jin in the past.
It was because Joshua didn't talk about the orb to the Prophet even after his fall and corruption.
If she had frankly revealed that such a thing had happened, it would have been clear what kind of treatment she would receive.
"Jin, destroy this with the Spirit Sword."
What Valeria had revealed was that the orb was a link between the sealed Helluram and Inse.
As long as this link remains, even if the physical body of the Prophet disappears, the soul would return to the orb.
This was why the Prophet had told Jin, 'you can't extinguish me.'
Jin took the orb.
[Give it back! You dare not destroy it, it's sacred!]
"We have to find Diphus right away. He's barely holding on to his life trying to stop the curse."
Jin's pupils widened.
"Is he holding on, trying to stop the curse?"
"It seems that his sanity has returned. It can't just be a whim."
"…Got it."
The white dimensional gate opened again, and Jin clenched the purple orb as if to crush it.
[No, please. Mother, mother! Can you hear my voice...!]
Soon, Jin threw the orb into the air and unleashed the Spirit Sword First Form, Soul Slash.
["Ah, ah! Mother!"]
Shattered...!
The orb was shattered in a single blow.
Splinters colored like blood spattered, and finally, the sight of the prophet vanishing began to reach Jin's eyes.
Whoosh-!
The spiritual energy, corroded by the Eternal Flame, was scattering and disappearing. The prophet's voice was no longer heard, and at that moment, Jin was...
He was engulfed in an intense intuition that couldn't be explained.
Just now, a sharp intuition that Diphus, who was resisting death somewhere on the battlefield, had taken his last breath, was piercing his heart like a knife.
The curse that Diphus had held did not ultimately revert to Rosa.
Just, as soon as Diphus died, the curse that remained in him was running wild. A giant black sphere was rising above Diphus's body.
The spiritual energy that formed the sphere did not enhance Diphus as before, nor did it infect the people nearby with chaos.
It merely caused an enormous explosion. As if hundreds of volcanoes were erupting at once, spiritual energy was bursting from the sphere relentlessly.
Jin immediately ran towards the sphere towards the outer wall. If left alone, the retreating allies would be killed in droves.
The first thing that came into Jin's sight when he reached the outer wall was Mary. She was kneeling in front of Diphus's corpse, panting for breath.
"We have to... save and take my brother, ah..."
Like a dandelion seed blown by someone's breath.
Diphus's corpse was disintegrating into particles.
Mary reached out to the scattering particles without thinking, then fainted and fell forward.
Ahead, a white dimensional gate and a steel door opened, and Valeria's party and Orgal appeared.
Orgal looked exhausted. As Jin had guessed, he had been disrupting the curse until now.
[Jin, now only you and I remain. If we stop the explosion and escape, the mission is a success.]
Jin struck a lump of spiritual energy that stuck out from the sphere towards the opposite sky. Each one could inflict fatal damage to the fleet.
Valeria examined the records left where Diphus had disappeared in the meantime.
There might be records worth telling to Jin and Mary later.
Mort swallowed Mary.
Syris and Valeria stood silently in front of the white dimensional gate heading towards the fleet. Jin nodded to them as if to tell them to go ahead.

"Valeria, tell Veradin. When the rescue of the allies is over, instead of a signal flare, have Kojak's cannon fire above the sphere. I think the signal flare won't be visible because of the explosion."
"Sure, come back safely."
As soon as Mort disappeared, Jin and Orgal threw themselves towards the sphere, which had become the power of the curse.
Kojak's cannon crossed above the sphere about ten minutes after that.
Before crossing the steel door, Jin took a moment to look back at the land where Diphus had disappeared.
If he hadn't returned at the very end, if he hadn't been able to resist death until the prophet finally vanished.
This mission would never have succeeded.
